attributes.name: Angelic Doll
attributes.powers:
When you acquire this card, you may recharge a random card from your discard pile.

At the start of a turn, display this card. While displayed, you may add 1 die and the Electricity trait to your checks that invoke the Divine or Outsider trait. At the end of the turn, discard this card; you may succeed at an Arcane 11 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
